item.name: The Diddlers
item.description: Forged in reverence to the Daedric Princes, these twin fangs carry a whisper from beyond the gates of Oblivion. Every crimson arc writes another blasphemy into living flesh; every wound deepens a patient venom. Their maker prayed for mercy. Something answered.
item.loreStatus: Original homage to The Elder Scrolls; not a quotation or a claim that this item exists in Skyrim.

visuals.grip: Upside-down reverse grip in both hands; blades point down/back behind the player.
visuals.bladeLength: Approximately 20 percent longer than the first gameplay concept; retain grip/guard dimensions.
visuals.idle: Existing narrow crimson energy channels glow within graphite/blackened metal.
visuals.attack: Each swinging blade leaves a bright crimson crescent slash trail following its actual animation, with brief red sparks on accepted impact.
visuals.movementTrail: Both carried daggers also leave thin, fading crimson tip trails while moving or running, independent of attack input. Native Item.Trails binds OT_Crimson_Movement separately to PrimaryItem and SecondaryItem at OT_Blade_Tip.
visuals.movementTrailClientDuration: Short native point history; exact time and appearance require client confirmation.
visuals.readability: Keep the blades, target and center view visible with restrained bloom; no permanent trails.
visuals.gameplayReach: Visual slash arcs do not extend the melee hitbox or create a ranged attack.
visuals.movement: Persistent thin crimson trails on both carried blades, independent of attacks, following OT_Blade_Tip while moving.
visuals.detail: Original per-face painted surfaces: continuous forged blade fields, incised motifs, beveled rim lighting, groove shadows, faceted crimson stones, inset fittings, worn corners and stitched leather.
visuals.movementTrailTimingNote: Native trail history is integer-valued; exact visible client duration is not asserted in seconds.

poison.name: Daedric Venom
poison.stackGain: One stack per accepted direct damaging dagger hit on a living target.
poison.refresh: An accepted dagger hit refreshes the shared six-second duration, including at ten stacks.
poison.expiry: All stacks expire after six seconds without another accepted dagger hit.
poison.pool: A target has one intrinsic Daedric Venom pool, shared across the two blades and all wielders; maximum ten total stacks.
poison.attribution: Retain attacker attribution for contributed poison damage and eligible kill/XP credit; stacking by another wielder must not silently steal all credit.
poison.tickScheduling: One periodic tick schedule per target. Refreshing or adding a stack must not reset or postpone the next scheduled tick. No immediate bonus tick on hit.
poison.defenses: Native Poison resistance, immunity and damage filters remain authoritative. Do not bypass defenses with another damage cause.
poison.scaling: Flat base damage; no percent-max-health scaling. Verify normal build modifiers once and avoid applying the same modifier twice.
poison.procSafety: Poison ticks cannot recursively trigger this stacking mechanic or count as fresh melee attacks.
poison.enchantments: Verify applicable native enchantments separately. Avoid duplicate callbacks or treating an external Poison-enchantment tick as a dagger hit.
poison.maximumUnrefreshedTail: At ten stacks, up to six scheduled ticks totaling 120 base Poison damage before defenses, assuming the target remains valid and no cleanse or cancellation occurs.
poison.balanceRationale: The native ability-poison effects deal 4 Poison every 2 seconds for 6 seconds. Two base DPS per stack starts at that native baseline, with a ten-hit ramp to a meaningful Legendary sustained-contact reward.
poison.cleanseCompatibility: Transient target component, not a native EntityEffect; generic status-cleansing items have not been verified to remove it.
